business.what: Polycab India manufactures and sells wires, cables, and fast-moving electrical goods, and executes electrical infrastructure projects for retail, industrial, and institutional customers.

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 27% a year over 5 years, 27% over 3 (steady); last 12 months 41%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 24% a year over 5 years, 28% over 3; last 12 months 28%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 101% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹236 cr, 0.02× equity; up from ₹118 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Revenue growth over the last 12 months significantly outpaced the historical three-year compound growth rate of 27%.
Return on Capital Employed has improved substantially from 21% in FY22, demonstrating strong capital efficiency.
International business and company revenue growth accelerated in H2FY26 compared to the first half of the year.

bear.point: Actual advertising and promotion spending is significantly below the stated target range of 3–5% for FY26.
BharatNet segment profitability is currently trailing the company's long-term margin target of 12–14%.
Management has ceased providing updates on critical Project Spring capex guidance and BharatNet execution timelines.
